sql: SELECT sku, SUM(CASE WHEN month='2026-07' THEN units ELSE 0 END) AS units_jul, SUM(CASE WHEN month='2026-05' THEN units ELSE 0 END) AS units_may, SUM(CASE WHEN month='2026-07' THEN revenue_ngn ELSE 0 END) AS rev_jul, SUM(CASE WHEN month='2026-05' THEN revenue_ngn ELSE 0 END) AS rev_may FROM kola.erp_sales WHERE city='Accra' AND channel='online' GROUP BY sku ORDER BY sku
